description: (Li)₂NaFeF₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Li clusters inside a NaFeF₆ framework. In each Li cluster, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaFeF₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.16 Å. Fe is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form FeF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Fe-F bond lengths are 1.94 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Fe atom.
